training_sources: public real YCB-V training scenes not current evaluation
user_policy.current_pallet_223: evaluation only: no fitting, feature statistics, augmentation choice, calibration, threshold, checkpoint, radius or crop selection
user_policy.PnP: forbidden; no new pose solve or pose optimization; existing pose-derived saved fields are provenance only
user_policy.v61: preserve checkpoint, outputs, labels, thresholds and old metrics byte-for-byte

coordinate_contract.query: unaltered initial query, never human reference centered/resized
coordinate_contract.nearest_pixel: floor(x+0.5), floor(y+0.5) at native raw image resolution; validity checks continuous and nearest pixel coordinates
coordinate_contract.native_order: 0 front top left,1 front top right,2 front bottom right,3 front bottom left;4-7 corresponding back;8 centroid excluded
coordinate_contract.synthetic_mapping: saved arrays are camera_dynamic_0123_v4; do not apply perm_v4 twice
coordinate_contract.real_mapping: use frozen evaluation preparation mapping only; SQUARE_YOLO:026048 stays UNKNOWN_MAPPING

VISIBLE_TARGET.meaning: target-instance visible surface occupies the exact query pixel

EXTERNAL_OCCLUDED_SUPPORT.meaning: target-only rendered silhouette has surface support at query but scene visibility removes it

OUTSIDE_TARGET_SUPPORT.meaning: background, target hole, outside target projection, or wrong target/query; mechanism not determined by these masks

INVALID_MASK_PAIR.handling: fail mask consistency gate; do not relabel

SELF_OCCLUDED_SEMANTIC.condition: not supplied by target-only full silhouette or visible silhouette
SELF_OCCLUDED_SEMANTIC.loss: masked as UNKNOWN; never turn into external-negative from absence alone
SELF_OCCLUDED_SEMANTIC.reason: full silhouette is already camera-facing target support; hidden semantic 3D corners may project onto another visible target face

sources.synthetic: M0 target-only binary silhouette, M4 final-visible binary silhouette; M4 subset M0 verified historically; pixel >127
sources.YCB-V: BOP per-instance mask (full) and mask_visib (scene visible); nonzero binary; mask_visib subset mask must be verified for each record

source_mask_labels.boundary: exact nearest-pixel target remains primary; 3x3 mixed mask is boundary_uncertain diagnostic. A finite-neighborhood target is a distinct auxiliary with radius fixed from source-only validation, never relabel exact target.
no_proxy_promotion: external-ray9 proxy is not physical visibility
convex-cuboid self is geometry proxy, not human native-corner self GT
projected cuboid point mask membership is not semantic DIRECT GT

human_evaluation_labels.DIRECT_VISIBLE: existing human corner identity is visible; pixel at initial query is not annotated
human_evaluation_labels.EXTERNAL_OCCLUDED: human target corner hidden by another object; not all absent-query pixels
human_evaluation_labels.SELF_OCCLUDED: human target corner hidden by the pallet itself; may project onto target-owned pixels
human_evaluation_labels.UNANNOTATED: preserve; no inferred labels from source pnp_projected or visibility=1
human_evaluation_labels.UNKNOWN_MAPPING: preserve8slots of SQUARE_YOLO:026048; exclude semantic metrics

evaluation.name: semantic keypoint visibility transfer of query-conditioned target-support classifier
evaluation.not_established: No current-real target-instance pixel GT exists, so no direct real exact-pixel accuracy or quantitative attribution of label mismatch versus domain transfer.
cohorts: paired_same_query_RGB: fixed legacy-compatible valid coordinate cohort
same_slot_pipeline: valid query, geometry S kept separate
evaluation.new_model_call: p_visible compared with source-only frozen threshold for visible/absent transfer. If explicit support-state classes are output, show VISIBLE/EXTERNAL_SUPPORT/OUTSIDE_SUPPORT separately; never call all absent predictions external.
evaluation.legacy: unchanged historical CAL46 comparator: B/I visible,O external,U unresolved,geometricS remains separate RGB-before-gate provenance. S counts as nonvisible only in D_vs_S and D_vs_ES pipeline.
evaluation.precision: correct decided class / all predictions of that class
evaluation.recall: correct decided class / all human support including abstentions/unresolved
evaluation.coverage: report decisions, U, geometryS/out-of-task, invalid separately
evaluation.threshold: v61 .5 preserved; new-model threshold/source epoch frozen before first current-eval inference; never select on current223
evaluation.location_error: evaluation-only error_to_reference<=3,3to10,10to30,>30px and reference_inside_nominal_crop. These are diagnostic strata, not verified query-miss ground truth. Human reference can be manual_click, locked_DEV, pnp_projected or unknown; report source.
evaluation.paired_changes: same fixed rows, report improved/damaged/unresolved and frame-group counts; no new GT-best permutation
evaluation.exposure: Current223 repeatedly examined development material; current experiment exclusion does not make it independent final holdout.

source_selection.partition: existing synthetic train/validation split; YCB-V disjoint scene split from public train, split before sampling queries
source_selection.checkpoint: fixed training budget and source-only validation objective written before fitting; head variants report separately
source_selection.threshold: predeclare0.5 or choose only public/synthetic validation; save rule and validation artifact SHA

completion_limits.this_first_head: intervention test, not proof that broad pallet semantic occlusion problem is solved
completion_limits.self_solution_needs: verified semantic self source supervision/identity and evidence; mask_full and mask_visib alone insufficient
completion_limits.SAM_candidate: target-prompt-conditioned segmentation may supply target-support evidence; validate multiple-instance ownership, holes, boundaries, external occluders. Keep pretrained/frozen or public-source adaptation provenance. SAM mask cannot by itself supply hidden semantic native-corner self state.
